title: Sandiganbayan suspends Tarlac Rep. Noel Rivera
summary: The Sandiganbayan ordered the 90-day preventive suspension of Tarlac Third District Rep. Noel Rivera as he faces graft cases over alleged conflict of interest in infrastructure projects.
